qualification_target.primary_claim: For one prospectively frozen target case generator, the unconditional probability that a fresh declared holdout campaign has zero strict exceedances in every acceptance-bearing numerical family is at least 1 - alpha_familywise.
qualification_target.marginal_per_case_claim: A separate order-statistic construction may claim a bound on one fresh case from the same target population.
qualification_target.applicability_scope: The mixture claim applies only to the declared mixture population. It does not establish coverage for every named component or every possible workload cell.
non_claims: No conditional-on-calibration coverage claim is made.
No per-cell claim follows from a pooled mixture claim.
No claim transfers to a changed model, comparator, backend path, generator, or applicability key.

mixture_population_requirements.rationale: A fixed independent draw from the same declared mixture makes the numerical-error value marginally exchangeable even when component cells have different conditional error distributions. This supports only the stated mixture-population claim.

construction_requirements.POOLED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION: Use only for an IID frozen mixture population. A calibration maximum gives the campaign strict-exceedance identity H/(N+H) for N calibration and H holdout cases. A different selected order statistic must state its rank identity.
construction_requirements.STRATIFIED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION: Use when the target requires coverage in named strata. Declare each stratum and its campaign allocation before calibration. Within-stratum exchangeability supports a stratum term H_s/(N_s+H_s); compose all strata and metrics with a valid union bound unless a stronger justified dependence result is declared.
construction_requirements.MARGINAL_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION: State a per-case claim separately from a zero-exceedance campaign claim. For N calibration cases and kth order statistic, the strict-exceedance probability is (N+1-k)/(N+1) under exchangeability, with ties conservative.
construction_requirements.PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED_PARAMETRIC_PREDI: Declare the distribution, transformation, fitting rule, model-check rule, extrapolation boundary, and failure disposition before physical calibration. It must not claim distribution-free coverage.
construction_requirements.AUDITABLE_HIERARCHICAL_PREDICTION: Declare all hierarchy, pooling, prior or estimator, posterior/predictive coverage theorem, and failure modes before calibration. It is not permitted until its stated theorem covers the required named-stratum or mixture target.

POOLED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.assumptions: Calibration and holdout cases are IID draws from one frozen mixture target. The mixture includes the component-selection rule and weights.
POOLED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.finite_sample_guarantee: For a calibration maximum and H future cases, strict exceedance is at most H/(N+H). It is exact for continuously distributed exchangeable values. A selected order statistic needs its own rank guarantee.
POOLED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.familywise_composition: Allocate a predeclared error budget to each acceptance-bearing metric and use Bonferroni or a stronger valid bound.
POOLED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.sample_burden_scaling: For a fixed future campaign size, the maximum-based bound decreases as N increases. The method does not provide per-component coverage.
POOLED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.failure_modes: A changed generator, changed mixture weights, non-IID sampling, or a per-component claim invalidates the pooled guarantee. Ties make strict-exceedance identities conservative bounds.

STRATIFIED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.assumptions: Calibration and holdout values are exchangeable within each named stratum. Strata and future campaign allocation are frozen before calibration.
STRATIFIED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.finite_sample_guarantee: For a stratum maximum, strict exceedance is at most H_s/(N_s+H_s). The covered campaign is at most the union over strata before metric composition.
STRATIFIED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.familywise_composition: Compose named-stratum paths and acceptance-bearing metrics with Bonferroni or a stronger valid bound. Do not assume stratum or metric independence.
STRATIFIED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.sample_burden_scaling: Each protected stratum consumes its own calibration burden. Rare or high-risk strata can dominate the total burden.
STRATIFIED_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.failure_modes: A missing stratum, changed allocation, invalid within-stratum exchangeability, or undeclared cross-stratum pooling invalidates the claim. Ties make strict-exceedance identities conservative bounds.

MARGINAL_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.assumptions: One future case and N calibration cases are exchangeable under the declared mixture or named-stratum target.
MARGINAL_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.finite_sample_guarantee: For kth calibration order statistic, strict exceedance is at most (N+1-k)/(N+1), with equality for continuously distributed exchangeable values.
MARGINAL_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.familywise_composition: Compose metric-level marginal error budgets with Bonferroni or a stronger valid bound. Do not present this as a zero-exceedance campaign guarantee.
MARGINAL_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.sample_burden_scaling: The available rank resolution improves as N increases. A campaign claim requires separate accounting for its future case count.
MARGINAL_ORDER_STATISTIC_PREDICTION.failure_modes: Generator or applicability drift invalidates exchangeability. Confusing a marginal bound with a campaign bound is a failed contract. Ties make the stated strict-exceedance result conservative.

PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED_PARAMETRIC_PREDI.assumptions: A predeclared distribution and transformation describe the applicable tail. Fitting, model checking, and extrapolation limits are frozen before physical calibration.
PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED_PARAMETRIC_PREDI.finite_sample_guarantee: Only the stated model-based predictive theorem applies. This class has no distribution-free guarantee.
PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED_PARAMETRIC_PREDI.familywise_composition: Compose valid model-based per-metric predictive bounds with Bonferroni or a stronger theorem that states its dependence assumptions.
PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED_PARAMETRIC_PREDI.sample_burden_scaling: Calibration must support model fitting and an independent predeclared validation procedure. Tail and stratum complexity increase the required evidence burden.
PROSPECTIVELY_VALIDATED_PARAMETRIC_PREDI.failure_modes: Model misspecification, failed diagnostics, unsupported tail extrapolation, or validation failure produces no qualification claim and requires a fail-closed disposition.

AUDITABLE_HIERARCHICAL_PREDICTION.assumptions: The frozen hierarchy, pooling rule, estimator or prior, and target-population relation are correct for every claimed component.
AUDITABLE_HIERARCHICAL_PREDICTION.finite_sample_guarantee: Only an explicit auditable posterior or predictive coverage theorem for the stated target applies. This class has no automatic distribution-free guarantee.
AUDITABLE_HIERARCHICAL_PREDICTION.familywise_composition: Compose metric and campaign risk with Bonferroni or a stronger stated theorem. Partial pooling does not remove the need to account for every claimed stratum.
AUDITABLE_HIERARCHICAL_PREDICTION.sample_burden_scaling: The burden includes enough observations to identify each protected level and to validate the declared pooling behavior. Added hierarchy increases validation burden.
AUDITABLE_HIERARCHICAL_PREDICTION.failure_modes: A misspecified hierarchy, unsupported pooling relation, failed predictive check, or uncovered stratum produces no qualification claim and requires a fail-closed disposition.

familywise_composition.requirement: The methodology allocates per-metric error budgets before calibration. Their valid union bound must not exceed the declared familywise error budget. Telemetry-only metrics are outside this qualification budget but remain mandatory finite-checked retained telemetry.
